title: Police Presence Is Not Public Safety
summary: From institutional presence through prevention, proportional response, survivor protection, reduced harm, trust, accountability and remedy.
map_question: What records are required before police presence is not public safety can support a bounded justice, safety, security or peace decision?
interpretation_boundary: A law on the books is not access to justice. Police presence is not public safety. An emergency declaration is not preparedness or recovery. Security capability is not protected rights or reduced risk. Defense spending is not security. A ceasefire is not durable peace.
